JOB INFORMATION

Job Title of Opening: Software Developer

Position is for a Software Developer (internal title: Technical Lead) responsible for designing, developing, and implementing enterprise-level software applications for corporate clients. Duties include, but are not limited to: Design and implement data pipelines for extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL) customer data from multiple internal and external platforms; Ensure real-time synchronization and smooth data movement between systems, including CRM, ERP, and marketing platform; Develop and manage Master Data Management (MDM) solutions to maintain a Golden Record for each customer; Standardize and clean customer data to ensure consistency, eliminate duplicates, and enforce data governance policies; Implement automated data tracking, validation, and enrichment processes for accurate, up-to-date customer data; Work with cross-functional teams to integrate data solutions with business applications and provide actionable insights; Develop reports and dashboards for monitoring data quality, trends, and performance metrics; and provide ongoing support, enhancements, and optimization of data management platforms using Agile development methodologies. Performance of these duties requires working knowledge and utilization of the following software development tools and programming languages: Talend, Apache NiFi, Informatica MDM, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Kafka, MQ, SQL, Python, Java, Apache Camel, Apache Ignite, Spark, and Hive.

Requires a Master’s Degree in Computer Science and 1 year of experience. Experience as a Lead Software Engineer is acceptable. In lieu of above, will accept a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science and 5 years of experience, or any suitable combination of education, training or experience thereof.

Job Site: Employee is permitted to work remotely from his or her home residence, but must be willing to travel to various unanticipated client locations within the U.S. Frequency of travel is unanticipated.
